title: LSADRA Normalized Event
description: v1 (frozen 2026-09-30) — the normalized event emitted by collectors and ingested by the core at POST /api/events/batch. Attacker-controlled input: every string field is untrusted and bounded. Validators MUST enable format assertion (ipv4, ipv6, date-time). Keywords prefixed x-lsadra- are enforced by the core and are not expressible in standard JSON Schema. Compatibility policy: docs/contracts/README.md.

schema_version.description: Contract version this event conforms to. Any other value is rejected.

timestamp.description: Event time: RFC 3339 date-time with a mandatory UTC offset (Z or +/-HH:MM). Naive timestamps, epoch numbers and leap seconds (:60) are rejected. The core normalizes to UTC on ingest.

device_id.description: Registered device identifier. Server-assigned from the authenticated X-Device-Id credential; an event that carries it is rejected.

user_id.description: Owner of the registered device. Server-assigned from the device record; an event that carries it is rejected.

host.description: Hostname as reported by the log source.

effective_username.description: Account the event is attributed to.

source_ip.description: IPv4 (dotted quad) or IPv6 (RFC 4291 text form, no zone index) address of the actor, or null when unknown. Hostnames and empty strings are rejected.

event_type.description: Normalized event class, e.g. auth_failure, port_scan.

raw_message.description: Original log line, bounded. Untrusted input.

attributes.description: Source-specific key/values; the v1 extension point. At most 32 keys. Each string value at most 1024 characters; each non-string value at most 1024 characters when serialized as compact JSON (x-lsadra-maxValueLength). The whole object at most 8192 bytes as compact UTF-8 JSON (x-lsadra-maxSerializedBytes).
